sourceEvidence.title: Quality Assurance and Compliance Director
sourceEvidence.quote:
Role Summary
 
 Lead global quality assurance, product integrity, and regulatory compliance across apparel and other product lines. Develop and implement robust QA systems, including inspection standards and factory certification programs. Drive supplier improvement through structured guidance and performance expectations.
 
 Oversee product safety and compliance audits to ensure adherence to applicable regulations and internal quality requirements. Lead and mentor QA professionals and manage fulfillment audit teams to strengthen quality processes and consistency across the supply chain.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 
 Develop QA frameworks, inspection processes, and factory certification programs.
 Ensure product safety and regulatory compliance through audits and verification.
 Direct supplier improvement initiatives to enhance product integrity.
 Lead and manage QA staff and fulfillment audit teams.
 Establish quality standards and ensure consistent execution across product lines.
 
 
 Qualifications/Skills
 
 Strong expertise in quality assurance, compliance, and product safety.
 Proven leadership in audit teams and quality program development.
 Ability to implement supplier improve
